description: This file defines a base class 'Barcode' and several subclasses for different barcode types (e.g., I2of5, MSI, Codabar, Code11). It includes methods for validation, encoding, decomposition, size computation, and drawing of barcode symbols, utilizing the reportlab library for PDF generation.

classes.name: Barcode
classes.description: Abstract base class for barcode types, providing common methods for validation, encoding, size calculation, and rendering.

classes.name: MultiWidthBarcode
classes.description: Base class for barcodes with variable width elements, such as Code93 and Code128.

classes.name: I2of5
classes.description: Implementation of the Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, numeric-only, with options for size, checksum, and quiet zones.

classes.name: MSI
classes.description: Implementation of the MSI barcode, numeric-only, with options for checksum, size, and quiet zones.

classes.name: Codabar
classes.description: Implementation of the Codabar barcode, supporting start/stop characters and optional checksum.

classes.name: Code11
classes.description: Implementation of the Code 11 barcode, encoding digits and dash with options for checksum and size.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for barcode classes, initializing parameters and calling validation, encoding, and size computation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value for barcode encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated value into a barcode pattern.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Decomposes the encoded pattern into a sequence suitable for drawing.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the barcode for rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto a canvas.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle on the canvas, used for barcode bars.
